title: ValidationReport
description: Engine output consumed by both the operator and the Governor. Design goal: a failed report pasted into the Governor chat must contain enough structure (checkId, jsonPath, expected/actual, remediation) for the Governor to emit a corrected AGR without human interpretation. Every failure names the rule source so corrections trace back to the governing document, not to engine opinion.

configVersions.description: Exact config versions loaded for this run, for audit reproducibility.

artifactSha256.description: Hash of the emitted DOCX. Null when generation failed before rendering.

checkId.description: Stable ID from qa-checklist.json, e.g. QA-SF-08 or QA-SPEC-14.

jsonPath.description: Path into the AGR where the offending value lives, when applicable.

remediation.description: Actionable instruction phrased for the Governor, e.g. 'Replace [CLIENT] with canonical token [CLIENT ORGANIZATION NAME] in dataInputs.placeholderMap and all section blocks.'
